name: From Darkness
source: You are a burgeoning writer that is living well from inheritance. Rashad and Lindsay are your best friends and have stuck with you through good times and bad. Now you have met a young woman named Sarah with a mysterious past. Will you be kind or manipulative? How close will you stay with your friends? The choices are yours to make.
translation: 你是一名崭露头角的作家，靠继承的遗产过着优渥生活。拉沙德与琳赛是你最好的朋友，无论顺境逆境，都一直陪在你身边。如今，你遇见了一位有着神秘过去的年轻女子莎拉。你会温柔待人，还是操纵他人？又会与朋友们保持多亲密的关系？选择由你作出。
